sections.title: Roof Insulation - Climate Zone 4C
sections.text: Roofs shall have a minimum insulation R-value of R-30 continuous insulation (c.i.) for metal buildings, R-25 c.i. for all other roof types. Insulation installed above deck: R-30 c.i. minimum.

sections.title: Wall Insulation - Climate Zone 4C
sections.text: Above-grade walls: Steel-framed: R-13 + R-7.5 c.i. minimum. Mass walls (concrete/masonry): R-11.4 c.i. minimum. Metal building walls: R-13 + R-13 c.i. minimum.

sections.title: Fenestration U-Factor - Climate Zone 4C
sections.text: Maximum U-factor for vertical fenestration: Fixed: U-0.36. Operable: U-0.43. Curtain wall/storefront: U-0.38. Maximum SHGC: 0.40 (all orientations).

sections.title: Fan Power Limitation
sections.text: Each HVAC system having a total fan system motor nameplate horsepower exceeding 5 HP shall not exceed the allowable fan system power. Constant volume: 0.0012 W/CFM per inch of total static pressure. Variable volume: 0.0011 W/CFM per inch of total static pressure.

sections.title: Energy Recovery Ventilation
sections.text: Energy recovery systems shall be provided for systems with design supply air capacity exceeding 5,000 CFM and minimum outdoor air supply exceeding 70% of design supply air. Recovery effectiveness: 50% minimum.

sections.title: Interior Lighting Power Density
sections.text: The interior lighting power shall not exceed the interior lighting power allowance. Building Area Method: Office: 0.79 W/SF. Retail: 1.06 W/SF. Healthcare/Hospital: 1.05 W/SF. School/University: 0.87 W/SF. Parking garage: 0.15 W/SF.

sections.title: Lighting Controls
sections.text: Automatic shutoff: All interior lighting shall be controlled with an automatic shutoff device. Occupancy sensors required in: private offices, conference rooms, restrooms, storage rooms, and break rooms.

sections.title: Economizer Requirements
sections.text: Each cooling system having a mechanical cooling capacity exceeding 54,000 Btu/h shall include either an air economizer or a water economizer. Climate Zone 4C: Air economizer required for systems > 54,000 Btu/h.
